verdict.rationale: Firstbase's compliance dashboard shows per-state status, deadlines, and required actions, and its Registered Agent/compliance service handles notifications and multi-state filings, which supports timely annual report filing; community evidence confirms actual annual state filings (e.g., Wyoming annual returns) occur. However, franchise tax filing specifically is not directly documented — tax mentions focus on extensions and R&D credits rather than franchise tax itself. missing for 10: explicit franchise tax filing confirmation, independent verification of on-time annual report filing track record, details on deadline-miss guarantees or penalties handling.
